sources.text: The Widget controller reconciles Widget resources after its admission webhook becomes ready. Webhook readiness precedes Widget creation, controller reconciliation, and E2E assertions. Presubmits run unit and kind E2E jobs; periodic jobs run upgrade coverage. Read the failing JUnit case, then build-log, webhook resources, manager.log, and a passing job of the same flavor. example/widget-operator. artifacts/controller/manager.log. Shows reconciliation errors and webhook startup state. Webhook readiness failure. Tests report connection refused for the admission webhook. manager.log. webhook Deployment and certificate resource dumps. Do not infer a Widget reconciliation defect before webhook readiness is established. Change webhook startup or certificate configuration only when captured logs or resources prove it. Recovered API discovery timeout. A later discovery call succeeds and the test continues during the same run. Discovery never succeeds or the API service remains unavailable through failure.
